key.name: confirm-dangerous
key.summary: Ask before log out, restart, power off, suspend, shell reload, upgrades, emptying the trash and clearing recent files

key.name: preferred-terminal
key.summary: Preferred terminal (ptyxis, kgx, gnome-terminal, konsole, tilix, kitty, alacritty, wezterm, foot, x-terminal-emulator); empty means auto-detect

key.name: menu-layout
key.summary: Compact (button rows and toggle tiles) or classic (one row per action)

key.name: panel-icon
key.summary: Panel icon: 'easehub' for the bundled icon, or a themed symbolic icon name

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Panel area for the EaseHub icon

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position of the icon inside its panel area (0 is first)

key.name: toggle-menu-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the EaseHub menu (none by default)

key.name: enabled-actions
key.summary: Deprecated (1.2 and earlier): migrated to hidden-actions on first start

key.name: prefs-page
key.summary: Preferences page shown when the window opens (the last one used)

key.name: sudo-custom-minutes
key.summary: Minutes used by the "Custom" entry in the Sudo Timeout menu

key.name: sudo-global-timestamp
key.summary: Share one sudo login across all terminals (timestamp_type=global)

key.name: files-actions-enabled
key.summary: Add EaseHub actions to the Files (Nautilus) right-click menu

key.name: files-menu-name
key.summary: Name of the EaseHub submenu under Scripts in the Files right-click menu

key.name: files-layout
key.summary: Grouped (Copy, Open and Tools submenus) or flat

key.name: files-hidden-actions
key.summary: Files right-click actions to leave out

key.name: files-titles
key.summary: Custom titles for Files right-click actions (action id to title)

key.name: files-notify
key.summary: Show a notification after a Files action

key.name: files-editor
key.summary: Editor for "Open in Editor" (cursor, code, gnome-text-editor, gedit, kate); empty means auto-detect
